- [IARC.1.8] **Opaque handles.** The four handle types,
  `ds_engine_t`, `ds_fact_t`, `ds_schema_t` and `ds_json_t`, are
  opaque: `libds.h` forward-declares each, the integrator passes
  it as a pointer, and its layout is private to its owning module,
  so it can change without ABI churn ([IDAT.1.2], [IARC.6]). Every
  other type `libds.h` declares, the stream event `ds_stream_ev_t`
  among them, has its layout in `libds.h`.
